usage: 原创手掌、机械转轮、四姿态静态剪影、八帧跑步循环与六帧弹离动作；全部生成图片经无损 WebP 编码保存，颜色与透明度逐像素保持一致，按透明轮廓边界显示完整人物。

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original transparent cut-out asset for a WISE MOTION stop-motion paper collage film. Generate a single elegant adult human right hand, forearm entering horizontally from the LEFT, pinching fingers pointing to the RIGHT. Thumb and index finger form a narrow pinch as if gripping the end of a thin paper ribbon, but DO NOT include the ribbon or any other object. Side-view hand, beautifully legible anatomy, fingers all correct, hand occupies most of a wide 1536 by 1024 canvas with generous transparent padding. Cropped forearm in a matte charcoal wool jacket with a narrow off-white cuff. Medium: authentic black-and-white archival studio photograph printed on warm white matte paper and carefully scissor cut out, not a drawing. Visible fine newspaper halftone dots, deep charcoal ink with off-white highlights, subtle paper fiber and a slender irregular 5px white cut-paper outline around the silhouette. No sepia, no other colors, no background, no detached scraps, no text, no logo, no watermark, no graphic frame. True transparent background around the entire cutout, preserve the transparent alpha. High-detail skin creases, editorial art direction, direct flash archival photograph translated into rich monochrome ink print. This asset must be original and unrelated to any existing collage artwork.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one original mechanical flywheel cutout for a premium physical paper-collage stop-motion brand film, monochrome. Isolated single large industrial cast-iron flywheel viewed perfectly FRONT ON, centered circular object, eight elegant slender spokes, heavy dark rim, small machined central axle, intricate worn metal surface and engraved crosshatching. No perspective ellipse. Entire wheel visible with clear transparent gaps between spokes and a transparent axle hole. Style: a finely detailed 1920s engineering-catalogue steel engraving, printed with charcoal black ink on off-white paper, very fine halftone, scissor-cut outline following the exact outer silhouette and every inner spoke gap. The wheel itself has dimensional highlights and ink hatching. Palette ONLY charcoal black and ivory paper, no brown or sepia or color. 1024x1024 square canvas, wheel diameter around 850 pixels, transparent padding on all sides, true transparent background, no cast shadow outside the cutout, no glowing halo, no background paper square. No words, labels, letters, extra gears, hands, people or watermark. Rich archival print detail, strong large silhouette, usable as an independently rotating animation layer.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: an ORIGINAL four-frame photographic cut-paper animation sprite sheet for a WISE MOTION collage film. Square 2048x2048 canvas, exact 2 by 2 layout of FOUR equal cells, NO grid lines. In each cell, the SAME single adult runner in strict side profile facing RIGHT, entire body fully visible with generous transparent margins, centered on the cell, same body scale and same baseline. Runner wears a slightly oversized off-white long-sleeve work shirt with sleeves rolled to elbows, loose charcoal trousers and simple light canvas shoes, short dark hair, no hat, no logos; all clothing modest. Upper-left pose: crouched forward preload, both feet planted, arms bent. Upper-right pose: right-facing energetic running stride, front knee lifted and back leg extended. Lower-left pose: opposite running stride, one foot under hips, rear knee bent, arms switched. Lower-right pose: big right-facing airborne leap, lead leg reaching forward, back leg bent, arms spread for balance. Four visibly different poses of the same person, correct anatomy, no missing fingers or limbs, no additional people. Style: authentic 1960s high-speed studio motion photography translated into charcoal-black newspaper halftone on ivory paper, crisp rich shadows, visible coarse but beautiful print dots, scissor-cut white edge around each silhouette, tactile paper. ONLY grayscale black and off-white, no sepia, no colors, no background, no drop shadows outside the cutouts, no halo, no ground, no text, no watermark. True transparent alpha in all empty areas. This is a production sprite sheet, keep each figure well inside its own equal quadrant without overlap so each cell can be displayed independently by animation code.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: precise eight-frame run-cycle cut-paper animation sprite sheet. Input image 1 is the identity and material reference: preserve the SAME adult male, face, hairstyle, ivory rolled-sleeve shirt, charcoal loose trousers, pale canvas shoes, monochrome newspaper halftone and narrow irregular ivory scissor-cut outline. Primary request: replace the crude four-pose sheet with EIGHT consecutive anatomically coherent running poses for a smoothly readable full right-facing run cycle. Output ONE wide 2:1 canvas, preferably 3072 by 1536, EXACT uniform 4 columns by 2 rows, eight equal cells, no visible cell borders. Read poses left to right top row then left to right bottom row. Every pose stays fully inside its cell with at least 10% transparent margin on all sides, SAME body scale, SAME pelvis placement x50%, SAME camera angle strict right-facing side view. No pose overlaps or crosses a cell boundary. No entire-body rotation or translation across cells. Frame 1 right foot contacts ground ahead, left leg trailing, left arm forward. Frame 2 weight absorption: right knee bends, pelvis slightly lowers, left heel folds toward buttock, arms start switching. Frame 3 passing pose: right foot under pelvis, left knee swings forward, torso rises, rear arm swings forward. Frame 4 toe-off and flight: right leg extends back, left knee drives up and forward, arms opposite legs. Frame 5 left foot contacts ground ahead, right leg trailing, right arm forward. Frame 6 weight absorption on left bent knee, right heel folding, pelvis slightly lower. Frame 7 passing pose: left foot under pelvis, right knee swings forward, torso rising. Frame 8 toe-off and flight: left leg extends back, right knee drives up, leading naturally into frame 1. Natural opposing arm swing, clear changes of knees ankles and elbows between each frame, supple athletic motion rather than stiff walking, no repeated near-identical poses. The 2D photographic figure should remain about 72% of each cell height in the tallest grounded pose; ground baseline is y86% in each cell. Airborne frames both shoes a little above this baseline. CONSISTENT face and clothes. Monochrome charcoal black plus ivory, authentic archival photography converted into fine rich halftone print, no sepia or added color. Actual transparent alpha everywhere outside each cutout, no backdrop, no cast shadow, no floor line, no extra objects, no text, no numbering, no grid lines, no watermarks. This is one production sprite-sheet asset, not a poster layout.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SIX consecutive rebound/ejection animation poses as a cut-paper sprite sheet. Input image 1 is the character identity and print-material reference; preserve exactly this same adult man, face, short dark hair, rolled-sleeve ivory shirt, loose charcoal trousers and pale canvas shoes, grayscale archival photograph halftone with thin ivory scissor-cut border. Primary request: add the missing physical sequence of a runner landing on a springy paper platform, compressing, and being suddenly bounced away. One landscape 3:2 canvas, preferably 2304x1536, EXACTLY 3 equal columns by 2 equal rows, no cell borders. Six fully separated full-body poses, all limbs and shoes visible with at least 12% transparent padding inside EVERY cell, same anatomical scale, consistent side view with face towards RIGHT. Read left to right then next row. Frame 1 braced touchdown, front shoe planted, knee flexing, torso leaning forward, arms back for balance. Frame 2 deep compressed squat, both knees strongly bent, hips lowered, head and torso tucked, arms sweeping back, maximum spring loading. Frame 3 explosive spring release: supporting leg straightening on tiptoe, other knee drives up, body elongated, both arms swing upward, clear upward energy. Frame 4 airborne curled recoil: both feet off ground, knees tucking toward torso, elbows spread, surprised off-balance gesture, torso tilts BACK about 15 degrees. Frame 5 being bounced off: airborne chest leaning back about 30 degrees, arms flung open above shoulder line, legs spread loosely, knees bent, weightless startled silhouette. Frame 6 fully flung away: body tilted backward about 45 degrees, one knee folded and one leg stretched, both arms reaching out, loose airborne follow-through; still same right-facing man, no upside-down head. Make six poses clearly distinct and causally continuous, anatomically correct, no missing limbs, no duplicate poses. All six figures have identical head size, print dot size and clothing; do not scale crouched figure up to match standing height. Body stays centered in each equal cell. Transparent background true alpha, no paper rectangles, no platforms or props, no arrows, text, numbering, motion trails, ground, external shadows or grid lines. Charcoal black and warm ivory only, no sepia or colored pixels.
assets.layout_edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this six-pose sprite sheet ONLY to correct the production layout. Keep all SIX existing distinct character poses, identity, faces, anatomy, proportions, clothes, print texture and ivory cutout border unchanged. True TRANSPARENT alpha background must remain. Place the same six figures in an EXACT 3-column by 2-row grid of equal square cells on one landscape 3:2 image. Uniformly REDUCE all six figures to 72 percent of their current size, using the same reduction factor for all. Center each figure's bounding rectangle within its respective cell. Reserve at least 60 transparent pixels from EVERY figure bounding box to every edge of its cell when cells are 512x512. No part of one pose can extend into another cell, and no pose's rectangular bounding box may overlap another pose. Preserve all hands, shoes and fingers inside their cell. Especially the bottom-middle figure's right shoe must be well clear of the bottom-right figure's left arm and head. Keep the original order: touchdown, deep squat, push-off on the top row; curled airborne, flung back, sprawled airborne on the bottom row. Do not regenerate or change the actions, only reposition and reduce them to fit safely in their separate cells. No background gradient, no checkerboard pixels, no floor, no labels, no numbers, no grids, no new objects. Output a single PNG with actual alpha transparency. This is a practical sprite atlas to be cut into six identical rectangular cells.
